aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds easy-to-use software for Food Trucks and mobile food businesses: online ordering, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build easy-to-use software specifically for Food Trucks and mobile food businesses, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time answering the same questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: But most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: make running a Food Truck easier, with tools designed around the way these businesses really operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from a simple observation: Food Trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people find Food Trucks that come to sell in their area, I spent more and more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, Food Trucks are always moving, working at different locations and serving customers in conditions that keep changing.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually make in time. The system calculates from each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare in one batch.

comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s fees: {cardFee} per card payment.

comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month} other {The first # months}} free, with every feature.
comparison.faq.locationsA: It does. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing trading places?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the Food Truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel at any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and you can keep using it until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract period?

comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS system and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your POS system is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS system with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the Food Truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or pay when they collect, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS system or card machine takes payment at the Food Truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a later date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo onto the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your Food Truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each date links straight to its own ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen (KDS), and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose internet signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook in one batch and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can’t choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward returning customers with digital stamp cards — collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Put items together as meal deals and offer add-ons at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for questions via Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — front counter and kitchen — showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login accounts with the right level of permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose internet signal, online ordering pauses so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline, while the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment up front when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that must be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter the cost of each dish and see how much profit you really made at each event, not just takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website, or from a picture you already post on Facebook. You just review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add your dates, places and times for each week and event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out with one tap — it turns grey for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count and it counts down as orders come in, then marks itself sold out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card machine.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, which spreads demand across your service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the Food Truck, paid on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically reply to WhatsApp questions about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook in one batch and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card machine you already use to take payment.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak or no phone signal. HatchGrab was built for that situation.
